target: For complex PSD Toeplitz T of size n+1 and rank n, prove strict positivity of the quadratic form on nonzero polynomials of degree < n, and simplicity of roots of every nonzero kernel polynomial of degree <=n. Combine with the proved unit-circle and full-degree conclusions to get n distinct unit-circle roots.
conventions: Same full Hermitian Toeplitz shift convention, ordinary ascending polynomial coefficients, padding to n+1, explicit nonzero assumptions. No arithmetic coefficient positivity is assumed or asserted.
next_representation_target: A positive n-atom Vandermonde representation in the corank-one case; this is a separate construction to be claimed only if actually completed. Arbitrary-rank representation remains separate.
DH_analogue: Identical finite linear algebra for DH-derived matrices satisfying the same PSD/Toeplitz/rank hypotheses. No arithmetic separator.
